decisions.rationale: Simpler; thoughts supersede each other via staleness check; prevents Ollama flooding
Bot walks ~100-200 units in the 2-4s a thought takes; anything more is a different spatial context
Matches dispatch interval + typical thought roundtrip; older warnings are almost certainly obsolete

decisions.decision: Halt only on high-severity ahead hazards (lava/ledge/drop)
decisions.rationale: Medium/low hazards should not block normal navigation; only prevent definite deaths
Pipe state persists across processes; previous crash can leave keys held indefinitely

decisions.decision: release_all(force=True) sends -action for ALL known keys, not just tracked ones
decisions.rationale: A new process cannot know what keys a crashed predecessor held; unconditional release is the only safe option
